task: Independently label all 768 supplied public English transcript candidates in raw-inputs.jsonl for a faithful cleanup specialist.
teacher_identity_note: Actual Muse identity as identified at session start; labels are teacher proposals, not independent review approvals.
stock_mode_notes: Default stock prose applied to 767 rows. One clearly addressed casual note to a named recipient (sotto-train-064765) labeled message: single line, informal, no trailing period, edit_policy=mode. No row was clearly email, note, code, or terminal on content alone; nondefault mode was not inferred from imperatives alone. No terminal-mode rows were assigned, so no formatting-off raw-exact terminal targets arise. Code-like literals inside prose (paths, endpoints, identifiers) were preserved in place under default.
variant_language_notes: All sources read as genuinely English prose, language=en. Keyword check for regional cues found only substrings (organize inside reorganize, labor inside collaborate) and no lakh/crore/prepone or regional spelling cue, so english_variant=unspecified for all 768; names alone were not treated as dialect evidence.
checks_run: Read task.txt, TEACHER.md, and stock-modes.json in full before labeling.
Read every raw in 12 pages of 64 (768 total), saving partial teacher-labels.jsonl after each page; final line count 768.
Validated id_order_exact=true against raw-inputs.jsonl, 768 unique IDs, exact 8-field key order on every row, and no empty targets.
Validated distributions: mode default 767/message 1; language en 768; english_variant unspecified 768; edit_policy minimal 578/repair 189/mode 1; confidence supported 759/uncertain 9.

Checked no target equals raw byte-exact (no forced no_edit rows; every raw needed punctuation/casing cleanup), no um/uh filler remains, and the sole message target is single-line with no trailing period.

Ratio-outlier refutation scan (<0.35 or >1.6 target/raw length): four rows, all explicit final self-corrections; one frame-drop found on recheck (sotto-train-100870) was fixed to retain the client frame and output SHA recomputed.
Confirmed uniform source provenance across all 768 rows (sotto-transcript-cleanup, revision 183cc8fd58532f13fa192980185214de1bcd5acc, MIT) and recomputed input/output SHA-256.
constraints_honored: No private, heldout, sibling, or upstream-output reads; no network, models/GPU, subagents, dependencies, git, or repository edits. Python was used only to match IDs in order and serialize individually authored labels, and for validation counts/hashes.
open_risks: Nine uncertain rows retain a best-faith target with a factual reason and require human review per TEACHER.md. Short self-correction repairs intentionally keep only the final corrected clause, which is the main residual interpretation risk.
